subject: ivy-emberose
q: Why can Harley never startle Ivy?
detail:
Harley Calder carries the third-largest ass in Ghost Haven and crosses the whole building without making a sound, and has taken a year off the life of nearly every woman here at least once. IVY IS THE SINGLE EXCEPTION and the reason has something to do with the humming. EVIE IS THE ONE TO ASK and Evie is in the garden being no use to anybody. The Archive has a guess about ambush requiring silence and a woman who is never listening to a room, and the guess is labelled as a guess and nothing is built on it.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER. Four years underground, alone, in the dark — the humming is echolocation. See c-ivy-underground. RETIRED.
